body: Sorry, I forgot to fill a description at the time. I was using `MultiplayerSynchronizer` to assign the volume in `AudioStreamPlayer`. When profiling I noticed that even though the volume did not change, it was still expensive to set the property. More specfically: - There was allocating and ref counting overhead of the `Vector<>` from `_get_volume_vector`. - `set_playback_all_bus_volumes_linear`, copies the `Ref<>` and `Vector<>` arguments. - `set_playback_all_bus_volumes_linear` doesn't pass in `AudioStreamPlaybackListNode` into `set_playback_bus_volumes_linear` resulting in 2 linear scans with `_find_playback_list_node` I would say though, that the bigger problem is that inside AudioServer, a lot of the methods are unnecessarily copying `Ref`, when instead they should be passed by const reference.
